# David Low

> David Low is Head of Technology at Vertex Holdings in Singapore and fractional Chief AI Officer at HeyHi. He has 15+ years in AI, data science and technology leadership. Previously Director of AI & Machine Learning at Singtel.

## Current roles
- Head of Technology, Vertex Holdings: leads the technology and Labs functions, including the proprietary investment platform, AI capabilities, corporate IT and cybersecurity. Source: https://vertexholdings.com/team/
- Fractional Chief AI Officer, HeyHi: AI strategy for a Singapore edtech platform. https://www.heyhi.sg/

## Previous roles
- Director, AI & Machine Learning, Singtel: led enterprise AI initiatives and scaled machine learning serving millions of customers; delivered the PRISM retention system and a ten month Cloudera to Azure Databricks migration (60+ data apps, 90+ ML workloads, 160+ dashboards, 1,000+ users).
- Head of Data Science, CardsPal (Standard Chartered Ventures backed fintech)
- Co-founder & Chief Data Scientist, Pand.ai (conversational AI for financial institutions)
- Data Scientist, Infocomm Development Authority of Singapore

- Emerging Leaders Award, The CIO Room Singapore 2026: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/thecioroom-singapore-visionawards-share-7526223560693121024-2x5z/

- Two Golds for Singtel, CCAS GCX Awards 2026 (Best AI Mastery in CX; Best CX Insights & Analytics Organisation): https://ccas.org.sg/awards/
- Winner, Asian Innovation Excellence Awards 2025 (Singtel PRISM): https://asianbusinessreview.com/co-written-partner/event-news/singtel-takes-home-accolade-asian-innovation-excellence-awards-2025
